notes: Codex app-server boot keeps its stderr and retries a boot that dies in the handshake. AppServerConn reads stderr line by line into a bounded tail (40 lines / 4 KB, rmcp transport spam dropped) and rejects pending requests with AppServerExit, which carries the exit code and that tail, so "codex app-server handshake failed" now says why (tonight: codex's own logs_2.sqlite locked by its prune, exit 1 before any logger). Each boot death is appended to <userData>/logs/codex-boot-failures.log with time, session, attempt, cwd and routed account. codexDriver.start boots (spawn → initialize → thread/start|resume) up to three times with 1.5 s then 4 s between, only while booting: an exit after the thread is up is reported as a crash as before and never retried; a retry that succeeds logs one app line. Tests in drivers/codex.test.ts over a fake process: the tail in the error and the log, retry-then-succeed, post-boot crash not retried.
